svg.aria-label: NFCtron. CISO and Head of Development. Cashless payments, ticketing and event management for live events across Europe. Own security, risk, incident response and every PCI and card scheme certification; led PCI DSS 4.0.1 and PCI MPoC. Build a native Android point of sale in Kotlin and the attendee app in React Native. Roll out AI agents: an internal Slack agent and shared tooling for coding agents. Bianca: POS mobile app for the fastest, most secure payments at events. Also runs ticketing check-in and access control. Tickets: Web event ticketing, seat reservation and cashless top-up. Hub: The motherboard of the NFCtron ecosystem and the B2B home for organizers, sellers and partners. API: The backbone that connects every NFCtron product to the world and to each other, fast, secure and scalable. Mobile apps: B2C Android and iOS apps for attendees, and soon for our payment cardholders. Nautilus: Our own fully certified, PCI compliant SoftPOS mobile terminal, with a Terminal Management System. Nebula: Card Management System for our own NFCtron payment cards, backed by an issuing license.
